title: AusKidTalk: developing an orthographic annotation workflow for a speech corpus of Australian English-speaking children
why_promising: Primary Australian-English child speech corpus with 57,508 target-word intervals used to evaluate alignment/transcription accuracy; pre-screened audio/TextGrids were manually corrected in Praat by trained annotators, with expert ground-truth files and reliability monitoring.
open_question: Locate a publicly downloadable release of the corrected target-word TextGrids/audio rather than only the workflow/code. The paper's data-availability statement does not itself expose the corpus data; admit only if the hand-corrected annotation layer is publicly accessible under reusable terms.

title: AphasiaBD: A Bengali Speech Dataset for Broca's and Global Aphasia
why_promising: New primary Bengali clinical speech dataset from 38 post-stroke aphasia patients; 335 audio clips from conversation, repetition, question-answering, and reading were manually segmented at sentence level and publicly deposited on Zenodo.
open_question: Current documentation establishes only sentence-level manual segmentation, not phone/vowel/landmark annotation. Keep out of the core phonetic-token layer unless finer manual annotations or derived acoustic measurements become available.

title: The MRP Corpus: A Speech Dataset of Modern Received Pronunciation
why_promising: Newly collected Modern Received Pronunciation corpus published 28 Aug 2026 with an open Zenodo deposit (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.15773908), making it potentially valuable as a recent primary English reference corpus.
open_question: Verify whether the released phone/word timing or pronunciation labels were manually created or exhaustively human-corrected. Current crawl verified openness and primary collection but not manual phonetic-boundary provenance.
